name: Shared Slack, GitHub and Gemini equipment
carrier: Codex desktop with Gemini gateway peers
capability: Composes named Slack/GitHub service tools and Gemini lifecycle operations into the existing Gemini gateway, with the same tool envelopes available to other local and Slack-connected harnesses. Existing provider credentials remain in service custody.
next_gap: Other provider tools can compose through the same equipment. Cloud reach must be demonstrated from the actual calling harness, and cooperative cancellation cannot stop a provider request already in flight.
